jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-tech operations fit at a company automating administrative work for care teams. The role centers on implementation, executive/client communication, project planning, stakeholder coordination, risk management, process improvement, and driving operational outcomes.
jobs.gap: The title is senior and the role expects substantial client-facing implementation ownership. Emphasize healthcare operations, systems/project work, training, workflow redesign, reporting, and cross-functional execution without overstating enterprise implementation tenure.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager (Provider)
jobs.location: United States · Hybrid/field-based · 25–40% travel for remote roles
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare implementation role owning end-to-end deployment of a voice-AI platform into health systems and digital-health providers. Strong overlap with clinical workflow mapping, implementation planning, documentation, training, stakeholder coordination, and operational scaling.
jobs.gap: The posting requires 5+ years specifically in health-system/provider implementation and may involve significant travel. Treat this as a strong stretch and lead with healthcare operations, onboarding, workflow design, training, documentation, and systems implementation experience.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong health-tech implementation fit involving provider and payer customers, executive/clinical/technical stakeholder meetings, project coordination, problem solving, and implementation delivery in a mission-driven healthcare environment.
jobs.gap: Arcadia values deeper healthcare-data platform and enterprise implementation experience. Emphasize healthcare workflows, systems projects, reporting, stakeholder management, training, and process improvement while keeping technical integration depth accurate.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: United States · Fully Remote · Occasional travel
jobs.why: Excellent alignment with healthcare SaaS implementation, workflow discovery, configuration, client training, go-live support, documentation, process improvement, and collaboration with Product and Engineering. The role explicitly values clinical-operations and practice-management implementation backgrounds.
jobs.gap: Direct EHR/EMR implementation experience is preferred, and the role expects technical curiosity around APIs/SDKs. Position technical knowledge accurately and emphasize workflow design, healthcare operations, training, systems troubleshooting, and implementation ownership.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - West Coast Preferred
jobs.why: Healthcare-tech implementation role supporting senior-living customers with project planning, workflow integration, training, post-launch support, stakeholder coordination, and process optimization. Strong overlap with onboarding, training, implementation, and healthcare operations.
jobs.gap: West Coast is preferred and the role can require heavy travel. Hardware/software implementation depth and longer implementation tenure are the main gaps, so treat this as a stretch unless the travel profile is acceptable.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Implementation Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote / New York City
jobs.why: High-upside healthcare implementation role in employer specialty pharmacy with strong overlap in prior authorization, eligibility/claims workflows, client implementation, project management, CRM tools, stakeholder communication, and process troubleshooting.
jobs.gap: This is technically demanding: ETL, APIs, SFTP, HIPAA/SOC 2, healthcare integrations, and SQL are explicit requirements. Keep SQL positioned only as foundational/working knowledge and treat the technical-integration requirements as the main stretch.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: New York City / United States · Remote considered
jobs.why: Strong systems-and-operations implementation role centered on complex software deployments, client engagement, operational process design, cross-functional execution, and turning ambiguous problems into scalable solutions. NYC preference is a plus.
jobs.gap: Moab prefers either deep equipment-rental industry experience or 4+ years managing complex software deployments. Emphasize systems implementation, project management, workflow automation, stakeholder coordination, and business analysis rather than domain expertise not held.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: High-paying business-operations implementation role at an AI-native regulated-finance company. Strong overlap with cross-functional execution, process design, enterprise implementation, operational problem solving, and coordinating technical/business workstreams.
jobs.gap: The role sits in a complex regulated-finance environment and is likely to expect deeper enterprise implementation experience than the current profile. Position business analysis, workflow automation, systems projects, documentation, and implementation skills as transferable strengths.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid · 3 days/week in office
jobs.why: Strong NYC business-operations fit focused on cross-functional projects, systems and process improvement, migration planning, documentation, operational requests, timelines, dependencies, and workflow automation. The role specifically values execution over deep technical specialization.
jobs.gap: E-commerce experience is not a core requirement, but the environment is data-heavy and some listings mention SQL. Keep SQL at foundational/working knowledge and emphasize program/project management, systems thinking, automation, and operational execution.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare growth-operations option in rehab-therapy software, centered on HubSpot workflows, CRM architecture, reporting, attribution, data integrity, martech integrations, process automation, documentation, and AI-enabled operational improvements. SEO is only a supporting responsibility rather than the core job.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 5+ years of marketing operations and deep hands-on HubSpot ownership. Lead with marketing background, analytics, CRM/process thinking, workflow automation, reporting, and systems projects without claiming HubSpot depth not held.
